records.literal_gloss: Of [the] sons of Korah, a psalm, a song. His foundation [is] on [the] mountains of holiness.

en.L: Of the sons of Korah: a psalm; a song. \q His foundation [is] on [the] mountains of holiness.
en.B: Of the sons of Korah. A psalm. A song. \q The city {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} founded stands on the holy mountains.
en.R: From the family of Korah. A song with music. \q God built {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} city on the holy hills.

fr.L: Des fils de Coré : un psaume ; un cantique. \q Sa fondation [est] sur [les] montagnes de sainteté.
fr.B: Des fils de Coré. Un psaume. Un cantique. \q La ville qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fondée se dresse sur les montagnes saintes.
fr.R: De la famille de Coré. Un chant avec de la musique. \q Dieu a bâti {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} ville sur les collines saintes.

sw.L: Ya wana wa Kora: zaburi; wimbo. \q Msingi wake [uko] juu ya milima ya utakatifu.
sw.B: Ya wana wa Kora. Zaburi. Wimbo. \q Mji alioujenga umesimama juu ya milima mitakatifu.
sw.R: Ya ukoo wa Kora. Wimbo wa kuimbwa na vinanda. \q Mungu aliujenga mji {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} juu ya milima mitakatifu.

es.L: De los hijos de Coré: salmo; cántico. \q Su cimiento [está] sobre [los] montes de santidad.
es.B: De los hijos de Coré. Salmo. Cántico. \q La ciudad que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} fundó está sobre los montes santos.
es.R: De la familia de Coré. Un canto con música. \q Dios construyó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ciudad sobre los montes santos.

vi.L: Của con cháu Cô-ra: [một] thi thiên; [một] bài ca. \q Nền móng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [ở] trên [các] núi thánh.
vi.B: Của con cháu Cô-ra. Thi thiên. Bài ca. \q Thành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập đứng vững trên các núi thánh.
vi.R: Của gia đình Cô-ra. Một bài ca có nhạc đệm. \q Đức Chúa Trời đã xây thành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên các đồi thánh.

ko.L: 고라 자손의 [것]. 시, 노래. \q 그분의 터전이 거룩한 산들 위에 [있다].
ko.B: 고라 자손의 시. 노래. \q 그분께서 세우신 성이 거룩한 산들 위에 서 있다.
ko.R: 고라 집안 사람들이 지은 노래. 음악에 맞춘 노래. \q 하나님께서 거룩한 언덕들 위에 그분의 성을 세우셨다.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the sons of Korah: a family of Levite singers
decisions.reason: The descendants of Korah, a Levite (Numbers 26:11), served as gatekeepers and singers at the temple (1 Chronicles 9:19; 2 Chronicles 20:19). Eleven psalms carry their name (42-49, 84-85, 87-88). "Of" may mean the psalm belongs to their collection or was written by one of them.

decisions.choice: a psalm, a song: two words for a song
decisions.reason: Psalm (mizmor) is a song sung to music (3:1); song (shir) is the general word. The two stand together in several titles (48:1; 65:1).

decisions.choice: his foundation: the city God founded
decisions.reason: The psalm begins abruptly with "his foundation". "His" is the LORD, named in verse 2, and what he founded is Zion: "the LORD has founded Zion" (Isaiah 14:32). The holy mountains are the hills of Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: a song of Zion
decisions.reason: Like Psalms 46, 48 and 76, this psalm celebrates Zion, Jerusalem, as the city God chose. Here it goes further: people from other nations are counted as born there (verses 4-6).

decisions.choice: the city he founded (B); God built his city (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "his foundation" refers to (m4) and Readable names God.

decisions.choice: "un psaume ; un cantique" for mizmor and shir at Literal and Balanced; Readable joins them as "un chant avec de la musique"
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for the Psalm titles: shir is "cantique" at Literal and Balanced, so it stays apart from mizmor.

decisions.choice: "zaburi" for mizmor and "wimbo" for shir (L, B); one phrase, "wimbo wa kuimbwa na vinanda", at Readable
decisions.reason: The title uses two words for a song; Swahili keeps two words at Literal and Balanced, and Readable joins them as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: salmo; cántico (L, B); Un canto con música (R)
decisions.reason: The title pairs mizmor (a song sung to music) and shir (song). Literal and Balanced say "salmo" and "cántico", the forms used in all the titles; Readable joins them in one phrase, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "thi thiên" and "bài ca" side by side
decisions.reason: The title has two words for a song (see the meaning decision); Literal and Balanced keep both, with "thi thiên" for the first as in the other titles, and Readable joins them, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "시, 노래" (L), "시. 노래." (B), "음악에 맞춘 노래" (R) for mizmor and shir
decisions.reason: Two words for a song stand side by side (meaning decision m3); the terms note gives "시" for mizmor and "노래" for shir, and Readable joins them, as the English Readable does.

source.text: אֹהֵ֣ב יְ֭הוָה שַׁעֲרֵ֣י צִיּ֑וֹן מִ֝כֹּ֗ל מִשְׁכְּנ֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: Loving [is] YHWH [the] gates of Zion more than all [the] dwellings of Jacob.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} loves the gates of Zion \q more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
en.B: The gates of Zion are dearer to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q than all the places where Jacob's people live.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} loves the city of Zion \q more than any other town in Israel.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aime les portes de Sion \q plus que toutes les demeures de Jacob.
fr.B: Les portes de Sion sont plus chères {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} \q que tous les lieux où habite le peuple de Jacob.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aime la ville de Sion \q plus que toutes les autres villes d’Israël.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayapenda malango ya Sayuni \q kuliko makao yote ya Yakobo.
sw.B: Malango ya Sayuni yanapendwa na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} \q kuliko mahali pote wanapoishi wazawa wa Yakobo.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaupenda mji wa Sayuni \q kuliko mji mwingine wowote katika Israeli.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ama las puertas de Sion \q más que todas las moradas de Jacob.
es.B: Las puertas de Sion le son más queridas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} \q que todos los lugares donde vive el pueblo de Jacob.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ama la ciudad de Sion \q más que cualquier otro pueblo de Israel.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} yêu các cổng của Si-ôn \q hơn mọi nơi ở của Gia-cốp.
vi.B: Các cổng thành Si-ôn được {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} yêu quý \q hơn mọi nơi dân Gia-cốp sinh sống.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} yêu thành Si-ôn \q hơn bất cứ thành nào khác trong Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온의 성문들을 사랑하신다, \q 야곱의 모든 거처보다 더.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 야곱이 사는 모든 곳보다 \q 시온의 성문들을 더 사랑하신다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이스라엘의 다른 어떤 마을보다 \q 시온 성을 더 사랑하신다.

decisions.choice: the gates of Zion: the city itself
decisions.reason: The gates, where the city's life and justice took place, stand for the whole city.

decisions.choice: the LORD chose Zion
decisions.reason: God's love for Zion is his choice of it above the other towns of Israel, as he chose Judah and Mount Zion rather than Shiloh (78:67-68).

decisions.choice: the city of Zion; any other town in Israel
alternatives: the gates of Zion; the dwellings of Jacob
decisions.reason: Readable says what the pictures mean (m1): Jacob is Israel.

source.text: נִ֭כְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּ֣ר בָּ֑ךְ עִ֖יר הָאֱלֹהִ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Glorious [things are] spoken of you, city of God. Selah.

en.L: Glorious [things are] spoken of you, \q city of God. Selah
en.B: City of God, \q splendid things are said of you. Selah
en.R: City of God, \q wonderful things are said about you. Selah

fr.L: Des [choses] glorieuses sont dites de toi, \q ville de Dieu. Sélah
fr.B: Ville de Dieu, \q on dit de toi des choses magnifiques. Sélah
fr.R: Ville de Dieu, \q on dit sur toi des choses merveilleuses. Sélah

sw.L: Mambo matukufu yanasemwa juu yako, \q mji wa Mungu. Sela
sw.B: Ee mji wa Mungu, \q mambo ya fahari yanasemwa juu yako. Sela
sw.R: Ee mji wa Mungu, \q mambo ya ajabu yanasemwa kuhusu wewe. Sela

es.L: Cosas gloriosas se dicen de ti, \q ciudad de Dios. Selah
es.B: Ciudad de Dios, \q cosas espléndidas se dicen de ti. Selah
es.R: Ciudad de Dios, \q se dicen cosas maravillosas de ti. Selah

vi.L: Những [điều] vinh hiển được nói về thành, \q hỡi thành của Đức Chúa Trời! Sê-la
vi.B: Hỡi thành của Đức Chúa Trời, \q người ta nói những điều vinh hiển về thành. Sê-la
vi.R: Hỡi thành của Đức Chúa Trời, \q người ta nói những điều tuyệt vời về thành. Sê-la

ko.L: 너에 대하여 영광스러운 [일들이] 말해진다, \q 하나님의 성아. 셀라
ko.B: 하나님의 성아, \q 사람들이 너를 두고 영광스러운 일들을 말한다. 셀라
ko.R: 하나님의 성아, \q 사람들이 너에 대해 놀라운 이야기를 한다. 셀라

decisions.choice: spoken of you: the words that follow
decisions.reason: The glorious things are probably what verses 4-6 go on to say: that the nations will be counted as Zion's own. God himself speaks in verse 4.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "thành" (the city) for "you" when the city is spoken to
decisions.reason: The singer speaks to Zion. "ngươi" is the old word for "you" in such a speech, but it is archaic and now sounds rude; Vietnamese can call the city by name or as "thành" and keep it as the one addressed. Used so through the psalm.

source.text: אַזְכִּ֤יר׀רַ֥הַב וּבָבֶ֗ל לְֽיֹ֫דְעָ֥י הִנֵּ֤ה פְלֶ֣שֶׁת וְצ֣וֹר עִם־כּ֑וּשׁ זֶ֝֗ה יֻלַּד־שָֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those knowing me; look, Philistia and Tyre with Cush: this [one] was born there.

en.L: "I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; \q look, Philistia and Tyre, with Cush: \q 'This [one] was born there.'"
en.B: "Among those who know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} I will name Rahab and Babylon; \q see Philistia and Tyre, and Cush as well: \q 'This one was born there.'"
en.R: God says, "I will count Egypt and Babylon among the people who know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q Philistia, Tyre and Cush too. \q Of each one it will be said, 'This person was born in Zion.'"

fr.L: « Je mentionnerai Rahab et Babylone parmi ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaissent ; \q voici la Philistie et Tyr, avec Koush : \q “Celui-ci est né là-bas.” »
fr.B: « Parmi ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaissent, je nommerai Rahab et Babylone ; \q voyez la Philistie et Tyr, et Koush aussi : \q “Celui-ci est né là-bas.” »
fr.R: Dieu dit : « Je compterai l’Égypte et Babylone parmi les peuples qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaissent. \q La Philistie, Tyr et Koush aussi. \q De chacun on dira : “Cette personne est née à Sion.” »

sw.L: "Nitawataja Rahabu na Babeli kati ya wale wanaonijua; \q tazama, Ufilisti na Tiro, pamoja na Kushi: \q 'Huyu alizaliwa huko.'"
sw.B: "Kati ya wale wanaonijua nitawataja Rahabu na Babeli; \q tazama Ufilisti na Tiro, na Kushi pia: \q 'Huyu alizaliwa huko.'"
sw.R: Mungu anasema, "Nitaihesabu Misri na Babeli kati ya watu wanaonijua {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}. \q Ufilisti, Tiro na Kushi pia. \q Kuhusu kila mmoja itasemwa, 'Mtu huyu alizaliwa Sayuni.'"

es.L: «Mencionaré a Rahab y a Babilonia entre los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conocen; \q mira, Filistea y Tiro, con Cus: \q ‘Este nació allí’».
es.B: «Entre los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conocen nombraré a Rahab y a Babilonia; \q y ahí están Filistea y Tiro, y también Cus: \q ‘Este nació allí’».
es.R: Dios dice: «Contaré a Egipto y a Babilonia entre los pueblos que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conocen. \q También a Filistea, a Tiro y a Cus. \q De cada uno se dirá: ‘Esta persona nació en Sion’».

vi.L: "Ta sẽ kể Ra-háp và Ba-by-lôn trong số những kẻ biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q kìa, Phi-li-tin và Ty-rơ, cùng với Cút: \q 'Người này đã được sinh ra ở đó.'"
vi.B: "Trong số những dân biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ kể tên Ra-háp và Ba-by-lôn; \q hãy xem Phi-li-tin và Ty-rơ, cả Cút nữa: \q 'Người này đã sinh ra ở đó.'"
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời phán: "Ta sẽ kể Ai Cập và Ba-by-lôn vào số những dân biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Cả Phi-li-tin, Ty-rơ và Cút cũng vậy. \q Người ta sẽ nói về mỗi dân ấy: 'Người này đã sinh ra tại Si-ôn.'"

ko.L: "내가 라합과 바빌론을 나를 아는 자들 가운데서 말하리라. \q 보라, 블레셋과 두로, 구스와 함께, \q '이 [사람]은 거기서 태어났다.'"
ko.B: "나를 아는 이들 가운데 내가 라합과 바빌론을 꼽으리라. \q 블레셋과 두로와 구스도 보아라. \q '이 사람은 거기서 태어났다.'"
ko.R: 하나님께서 말씀하신다. "내가 이집트와 바빌론을 나를 아는 백성 가운데 넣으리라. \q 블레셋과 두로와 구스도 그러하다. \q 그들 하나하나를 두고 '이 사람은 시온에서 태어났다'고 말하리라."

decisions.choice: I: God speaks
decisions.reason: "Those who know me" are those who know God, so the speaker is God. His words are the glorious things said of Zion (verse 3).

decisions.choice: Rahab: a name for Egypt
decisions.reason: Rahab is the name of a sea monster, a picture of chaos, that God defeats (89:11; Job 26:12). Isaiah 30:7 uses it for Egypt. It is not Rahab of Jericho.

decisions.choice: Philistia, Tyre, Cush: Israel's neighbors and the far south
decisions.reason: Egypt and Babylon were the great powers to the south and the east; Philistia and Tyre were neighbors and often enemies; Cush lay far up the Nile, south of Egypt. Together they stand for the whole world.

decisions.choice: born there: counted as citizens of Zion
decisions.reason: Nations that were Israel's enemies are written down as natives of the city of God. The prophets hope for the nations to come to Zion (Isaiah 2:2-3; 19:24-25). Galatians 4:26 speaks of "the Jerusalem above" as the mother of believers.

decisions.choice: God says
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker (m1).

decisions.choice: Egypt; born in Zion
decisions.reason: Readable gives the place Rahab stands for (m2) and names the city meant by "there".

decisions.choice: "Koush" for Cush
decisions.reason: The land south of Egypt. French keeps the Hebrew name in French spelling, as the English keeps "Cush", rather than the modern name "Éthiopie", which is a different country today.

decisions.choice: "Rahabu" kept at Literal and Balanced; "Misri" at Readable
decisions.reason: Rahab here is a poetic name for Egypt, not the woman of Jericho; Readable names the country, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Ta" for God speaking of himself
decisions.reason: God speaks here (see the meaning decision); in Vietnamese Scripture God says "Ta", as the style guide sets for the Old Testament, with the deity_pronoun setting in the middle of a sentence.

decisions.choice: "Ra-háp" (L, B), "Ai Cập" (R); "Cút" for Cush
decisions.reason: Rahab is a poetic name for Egypt (see the meaning decision); Literal and Balanced keep the name and Readable says Egypt, as the English does. "Cút" transliterates the Hebrew name; the older "Ê-thi-ô-bi" names a modern country.

decisions.choice: God speaks in 해라체 and calls himself "나"; the names are "라합" (L, B; "이집트" at R), "바빌론", "블레셋", "두로", "구스"
decisions.reason: As the terms note, God speaking uses 해라체 with 나. Rahab is a poetic name for Egypt (meaning decision m2), kept at Literal and Balanced and explained at Readable as the English Readable does; "이집트" and "바빌론" are the current spellings already used in the Korean New Testament (Matthew 2:13; 1 Peter 5:13).

source.text: וּֽלֲצִיּ֨וֹן׀יֵאָמַ֗ר אִ֣ישׁ וְ֭אִישׁ יֻלַּד־בָּ֑הּ וְה֖וּא יְכוֹנְנֶ֣הָ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And of Zion it will be said, "A man and a man was born in her," and he will establish her, [the] Most High.

en.L: And of Zion it will be said, "{{gender:This one and that one|This man and that man}} was born in her"; \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}, [the] Most High, will establish her.
en.B: And of Zion people will say, "Every one of them was born in her," \q and it is the Most High who will make her secure.
en.R: People will say about Zion, "All these people were born there." \q The God who is above all will keep the city strong.

fr.L: Et de Sion il sera dit : « {{gender:Tel et tel|Tel homme et tel homme}} y est né » ; \q et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, le Très-Haut, l’affermira.
fr.B: Et de Sion on dira : « Chacun d’eux y est né », \q et c’est le Très-Haut qui la rendra solide.
fr.R: On dira de Sion : « Tous ces gens sont nés là-bas. » \q Le Dieu qui est au-dessus de tout gardera la ville forte.

sw.L: Na kuhusu Sayuni itasemwa, "Huyu na yule alizaliwa ndani yake"; \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, Aliye Juu Kabisa, ataufanya imara.
sw.B: Na kuhusu Sayuni watu watasema, "Kila mmoja wao alizaliwa ndani yake," \q na ni Aliye Juu Kabisa atakayeufanya imara.
sw.R: Watu watasema kuhusu Sayuni, "Watu hawa wote walizaliwa huko." \q Mungu aliye juu ya wote atauweka mji huo imara.

es.L: Y de Sion se dirá: «{{gender:Este y aquel|Este hombre y aquel hombre}} nacieron en ella»; \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, [el] Altísimo, la afirmará.
es.B: Y de Sion dirá la gente: «Cada uno de ellos nació en ella», \q y es el Altísimo quien la hará firme.
es.R: La gente dirá de Sion: «Todas estas personas nacieron allí». \q El Dios que está por encima de todo mantendrá fuerte la ciudad.

vi.L: Và về Si-ôn người ta sẽ nói: "Người này và người kia đã sinh ra trong thành"; \q và chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, Đấng Chí Cao, sẽ làm cho thành vững lập.
vi.B: Người ta sẽ nói về Si-ôn: "Mọi người trong họ đều đã sinh ra tại đây", \q và chính Đấng Chí Cao sẽ làm cho thành được vững bền.
vi.R: Người ta sẽ nói về Si-ôn: "Tất cả những người này đều đã sinh ra ở đó." \q Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng cao hơn hết, sẽ giữ cho thành luôn vững mạnh.

ko.L: 시온에 대하여 말하리라, "이 사람도 저 사람도 그 안에서 태어났다." \q 지극히 높으신 분, 그분께서 친히 그 성을 굳게 세우시리라.
ko.B: 사람들이 시온을 두고 "이들이 모두 그 안에서 태어났다" 하고 말할 것이니, \q 지극히 높으신 분께서 친히 그 성을 든든히 세우실 것이다.
ko.R: 사람들이 시온을 두고 "이 사람들이 모두 거기서 태어났다" 하고 말할 것이다. \q 모든 것 위에 계신 하나님께서 그 성을 튼튼하게 지켜 주실 것이다.

decisions.choice: a man and a man: one after another, everyone
decisions.reason: Repeating the word for a person (ish) means "each and every one". The Hebrew word is used for people in general here.

decisions.choice: establish: make firm and secure
decisions.reason: The same verb is used of God establishing his city in 48:9. Zion's security rests on the Most High ('Elyon, 46:5), not on its walls.

decisions.choice: her (Zion)
decisions.reason: A city is feminine in Hebrew, and here Zion is pictured as a mother of the nations, so Balanced keeps "her"; Readable says "there" and "the city".

decisions.choice: the God who is above all
decisions.reason: Readable says what the title means (m2).

decisions.choice: "Aliye Juu Kabisa" for the Most High (L, B); "Mungu aliye juu ya wote" at Readable
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note gives "Mungu Aliye Juu Kabisa" for El Elyon; the title alone is kept with capitals. Readable says plainly who is meant.

decisions.choice: "Đấng Chí Cao" (L, B); "Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng cao hơn hết" (R)
decisions.reason: "Đấng Chí Cao" is the form already used for this title in the New Testament (Luke 1:32); Readable explains it in plain words, as the English Readable does. The block keeps these forms.

decisions.choice: "이 사람도 저 사람도" with no gender span
alternatives: {{gender:이 사람도 저 사람도|이 남자도 저 남자도}}
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "a man and a man" means everyone, one after another (meaning decision m1). Korean "사람" already means anyone, so there is no second wording to offer for the English span.

source.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִ֭סְפֹּר בִּכְת֣וֹב עַמִּ֑ים זֶ֖ה יֻלַּד־שָׁ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH will count in [the] writing of [the] peoples: "This [one] was born there." Selah.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will count, when [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}}] registers the peoples, \q "This [one] was born there." Selah
en.B: As {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lists the peoples in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} record, \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will write, "This one was born there." Selah
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will write down the names of the nations \q and say of each one, "This person was born in Zion." Selah

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} comptera, quand [{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}] inscrira les peuples : \q « Celui-ci est né là-bas. » Sélah
fr.B: Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} inscrira les peuples dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} registre, \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} écrira : « Celui-ci est né là-bas. » Sélah
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} écrira le nom des nations \q et dira de chacune : « Cette personne est née à Sion. » Sélah

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atahesabu, anapoyaandika mataifa, \q "Huyu alizaliwa huko." Sela
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapoyaorodhesha mataifa katika kitabu {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}}, \q ataandika, "Huyu alizaliwa huko." Sela
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataandika majina ya mataifa \q na kusema juu ya kila mmoja, "Mtu huyu alizaliwa Sayuni." Sela

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} contará, cuando [{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}] inscriba a los pueblos: \q «Este nació allí». Selah
es.B: Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} anote a los pueblos en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} registro, \q escribirá: «Este nació allí». Selah
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escribirá los nombres de las naciones \q y dirá de cada una: «Esta persona nació en Sion». Selah

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đếm, khi [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] ghi sổ các dân: \q "Người này đã sinh ra ở đó." Sê-la
vi.B: Khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ghi tên các dân vào sổ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ viết: "Người này đã sinh ra ở đó." Sê-la
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ ghi tên các dân tộc \q và nói về mỗi dân: "Người này đã sinh ra tại Si-ôn." Sê-la

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 민족들을 기록하실 때 세시리라, \q "이 [사람]은 거기서 태어났다." 셀라
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 민족들을 명부에 올리실 때 \q "이 사람은 거기서 태어났다" 하고 적으실 것이다. 셀라
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 민족들의 이름을 적으시며 \q 그 하나하나를 두고 "이 사람은 시온에서 태어났다" 하고 말씀하실 것이다. 셀라

decisions.choice: the register of the peoples: God's book of citizens
decisions.reason: A city kept a list of its citizens. Scripture speaks of God's book of the living (69:29; Exodus 32:32; Isaiah 4:3). Here God himself enrolls the nations as born in Zion.

decisions.choice: born in Zion
decisions.reason: Readable names the city (as in verse 4).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

records.literal_gloss: And singers as dancers: "All my springs [are] in you."

en.L: And singers as well as dancers [will say], \q "All my springs [are] in you."
en.B: Those who sing and those who dance will say, \q "All my springs rise in you."
en.R: People will sing and dance and say to Zion, \q "All the good things in my life come from you."

fr.L: Et chanteurs aussi bien que danseurs [diront] : \q « Toutes mes sources [sont] en toi. »
fr.B: Ceux qui chantent et ceux qui dansent diront : \q « Toutes mes sources jaillissent en toi. »
fr.R: Les gens chanteront et danseront, et ils diront à Sion : \q « Tout ce qu’il y a de bon dans ma vie vient de toi. »

sw.L: Na waimbaji pamoja na wachezaji [watasema], \q "Chemchemi zangu zote [ziko] ndani yako."
sw.B: Wanaoimba na wanaocheza watasema, \q "Chemchemi zangu zote zinabubujika ndani yako."
sw.R: Watu wataimba na kucheza na kuuambia Sayuni, \q "Mema yote ya maisha yangu yanatoka kwako."

es.L: Y tanto cantores como danzantes [dirán]: \q «Todas mis fuentes [están] en ti».
es.B: Los que cantan y los que danzan dirán: \q «Todos mis manantiales brotan en ti».
es.R: La gente cantará, bailará y le dirá a Sion: \q «Todo lo bueno de mi vida viene de ti».

vi.L: Cả những người ca hát lẫn những người nhảy múa [sẽ nói]: \q "Mọi nguồn suối của tôi đều [ở] trong thành."
vi.B: Những người ca hát và những người nhảy múa sẽ nói: \q "Mọi nguồn suối của tôi đều tuôn ra từ nơi thành."
vi.R: Người ta sẽ ca hát, nhảy múa và nói với Si-ôn: \q "Mọi điều tốt lành trong đời tôi đều đến từ nơi thành."

ko.L: 노래하는 이들도 춤추는 이들도 [말하리라], \q "나의 모든 샘이 네 안에 [있다]."
ko.B: 노래하는 이들과 춤추는 이들이 말할 것이다. \q "나의 모든 샘이 네 안에서 솟는다."
ko.R: 사람들이 노래하고 춤추며 시온에게 말할 것이다. \q "내 삶의 좋은 것은 모두 너에게서 온다."

decisions.choice: singers and dancers: those who celebrate Zion
decisions.reason: The verse is very short and has no verb; the words "will say" are supplied. The singers and dancers are probably the peoples born in Zion, celebrating the city in song.

decisions.choice: my springs: the sources of life and blessing
decisions.reason: Springs are where water and life come from. In Zion is the river that makes the city glad (46:5) and the fountain of life (36:10).

decisions.choice: will say
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no verb; Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: all the good things in my life come from you
alternatives: all my springs are in you
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m2) and names Zion as the one addressed.
